# Filter drivers with more than 75 laps
above_75 = df[df['laps'] > 75]

# Check if any driver in above_75 has a time/retired status indicating trouble
# Trouble indicators: contains "lap" (for + X laps), or any non-time status like "engine", "gearbox", etc.
def has_trouble(status):
    status_str = str(status).lower()
    # Trouble if contains "lap" (for + X laps) or is not a time format (doesn't contain ':')
    return 'lap' in status_str or ':' not in status_str

trouble_drivers = above_75[above_75['time / retired'].apply(has_trouble)]

# Check if there are exactly 9 such drivers
answer = len(trouble_drivers) == 9
